subject: MSA + Order Form: commercial redlines & signoff runbook
messages:
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme.io>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Alvarez <diego.alvarez@acme.io>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft Order Form (pricing + net terms)

Hi Camila —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Procurement asked us to get the redlines in one place so we can quickly move to countersignature. Attached is the Order Form with our edits (pricing schedule updates, a couple of minimum-commit clarifications, and a request to push Net 60 to Net 45).

Quick summary of the salient points from our side: 
- Pricing: want a 6-month step-down on the first tranche if we exceed token thresholds (we captured example language on p3)
- Minimum commitment: asking to make the initial tranche refundable if not activated by month 3 (this is a commercial ask)
- Net term change: prefer Net 45 instead of Net 30 given internal AP_cycle
- Tax: Acme requests Redwood provide a VAT registration note for EU invoicing; attaching our tax team contact.

Can you confirm who on your side will handle legal redlines vs finance? Our goal is to have a final countersigned Order Form by 7/23. If that date is tight please flag.

Regards,
Sofia
Sofia Martinez
Head of Procurement, Acme IoT

Attachment: ACME_OrderForm_Redlines_20260720.pdf (pdf, 12 pages)
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme.io>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft Order Form (pricing + net terms)

Sofia —

Appreciate the consolidated redlines and the clear deadline. Quick replies inline: 

- Pricing step-down: Commercial OK to model the example language but want to preserve a minimum floor; Ben, can you confirm the math and draft alternative wording?
- Refundable tranche if not activated: This is a sales-side ask; we can propose a conditional credit structure rather than a cash refund. Ben, please prepare a one-paragraph alternative.
- Net terms: We generally target Net 30 for new accounts. Laura, is Net 45 possible for Acme given their size? If not we can offer Net 45 for the first year with a payment schedule milestone.
- Tax/VAT evidence: I see the Acme tax cert attachment — Markus, can legal/ops produce the VAT registration note and confirm invoicing entity?

I'll start a short runbook in this thread so we don't lose track: 1) Ben to provide revised commercial language (by EOD 7/20), 2) Markus to produce legal redline of MSA/OrderForm (by EOD 7/21), 3) Laura to confirm finance payment terms and exceptions (by 7/21), 4) Camila to assemble final doc and send for signature (target 7/22).

If any of you can't hit those dates, call it out. Sofia — we'll aim to surface a consolidated counter by tomorrow.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme.io>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 19:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft Order Form (pricing + net terms)

Camila / Sofia —

Thanks — I reviewed the step-down language. Short version: Acme's proposed thresholds look reasonable but we should add a min-commit floor at 60% of tranche value to protect unit economics. I've attached a one-paragraph alternative to replace p3 (see below). Also: the refundable-tranche ask is big for us; proposed compromise is a 6-month credit equal to 25% of tranche fees if not activated, credited against next invoice.

Proposed commercial snippet: "If monthly average token usage for the first 6 months following activation exceeds the threshold defined in Schedule A, pricing for subsequent months will step down to the corresponding tier, provided that total billed usage for the initial tranche meets at least 60% of the tranche commitment. Failure to meet 60% will not retroactively change invoicing for the initial tranche."

If that reads OK to Acme, we can fold it into the redline.

Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Commercial_Snippet_for_Acme.txt (text, 1 page)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@acme.io>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: commercial redlines & signoff runbook

Team —

I reviewed the attached Order Form and the commercial edits. High-level legal guidance: 
1) We can accept the proposed pricing step-down language with Ben's 60% floor. I'll add defensive language to limit retrospective adjustments and clarify measurement windows.
2) Refundable tranche: we should avoid cash refunds. The 6-month credit is acceptable provided we limit the credit to service fees and exclude pass-through costs.
3) Net terms: offering Net 45 for the first 12 months with a contract clause that reverts to Net 30 thereafter is acceptable from a credit risk perspective, but finance must confirm with collections.
4) Tax/VAT: we need Acme's VAT registration evidence and the correct legal entity for invoicing. I referenced Acme's tax contact in the draft redline; attaching my redline.

Please see attached: Redline_20260721_MSA_OrderForm_markus.pdf (legal redline) — highlights: edits to Section 2 (Pricing), Section 5 (Payment terms), and Schedule A (Pricing schedule).

I'll be available on a call at 11:30 if we want to walk through the redlines quickly.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
